title: BTS Marks 13th Anniversary With Two-Night Busan Asiad Stadium Homecoming
detail: June 12-13, 2026 — BTS closes BTS FESTA 2026 with two sold-out nights at Busan Asiad Main Stadium, their first return to the city since 'Yet To Come in Busan' in 2022 — the show remembered as the group's final concert before all seven members enlisted for mandatory military service. The two nights draw approximately 220,000 fans combined, with roughly 110,000 attending the June 13 finale on the exact 13th debut anniversary. Busan holds special significance as the hometown of members Jimin and Jungkook. Setlists spanned the group's catalogue from 'Ma City' and 'Not Today' to ARIRANG-era tracks, with June 13 closing on an emotional note as the members addressed the crowd about the meaning of returning to Busan as a full group for the first time since their pre-enlistment farewell.

media.caption: BTS closes their 13th anniversary FESTA with an emotional two-night homecoming at Busan Asiad Main Stadium.
